evidenceCards.practicalMeaning: The harness can inspect a live Android screen and refuse an interactive action under read-only policy with an agent-readable denial.
A setup session can prepare an app, then a read-only agent session can inspect the business UI while policy blocks a state-changing Login action.
The narrow differentiation is not better tapping; it is a governance control plane for AI agents that should observe first and act only when policy allows it.
The same agent intent can be refused under read-only policy, remediated, then retried through an explicit interactive session without changing tool code or bypassing governance.
